Location: `artifacts/local/dispatch-name-binding16-reviewed.py:72–73`.

The reused five-state idle gate checks an integer total_count, its equality with len(workflow_runs), and workflow_runs falsiness, but never requires a list. Require a dictionary response and list-valued workflow_runs before evaluating count/emptiness, retaining literal integer count and exact full-inventory equality.
